Gluing along sixteen points contributes fifteen circles. Standalone independent enumerator confirms all f-vectors and modular Betti numbers.

value.rationale: The join of two tetrahedral boundaries is a canonical triangulated five-sphere distinct from a simplex. Its double has a free nontrivial fundamental group and 78 integral two-sphere summands, realizing sharp connectivity from the recent general theorem. The explicit chessboard-plus-cone structure makes the failure and full homotopy type intelligible.
